lines: STREET LIGHTING. These lamps are switched off at 22.00 to save the county money.
Residents are advised that this has always been the case.
CASTLE BRIDGE. No toll is taken here now. The keeper is not employed.
CASTLE RURAL DISTRICT COUNCIL. NO BATHING.
Painted underneath, smaller: Nobody has drowned in this lake.
He is wet to the collar and he is watching the water, not you.
"It's only a lake," he says. "Nobody's ever drowned in it. I'd know."
